title: Second Month. Just Got The August Box..
text:
[[VIDEOID:4cb51571d146785c0f99045f2d6cddac]] Well I just received the August box and I will definitely use all but one product (The Cargo Lip Stick Is To Bright For Me)... but I Love everything else. Definitely worth the $15 bucks and I really like the Nuria applicator.
To anyone out there that needs to brighten up the eye area, the Laritzy Liquid Beam is AMAZING for brightening around the eyes, brow bone and cheek bone. Alittle goes a LONG way..
They're Real mascara is one of my favorites ( I'm older and have NO lashes left)... The last photo (not the best pic) shows one eye with, one eye without and no other makeup.
Hope this helps..
Stay Beautiful!
label: positive
